nodes.rationale: Tagline positions the product as a diagnostics-and-tuning tool specifically for ECU (Engine Control Unit) work, narrowing the brand from a generic name to a defined product category.

nodes.label: Ascending Bars + Trend-Line Logo Icon
nodes.rationale: Icon depicts a row of vertical bars rising in height (gray/dark bars on the left transitioning to orange bars on the right), connected by a dotted-then-solid cyan line that plots across the bar tops like a dyno or performance chart. Design intent: visually encode 'tuning progress' as an upward performance curve, echoing dyno power/torque graphs used in motorcycle ECU tuning, so the mark reads as data-driven performance improvement rather than a generic abstract logo.

nodes.label: Cyan-to-Orange Gradient Color Scheme
nodes.rationale: Dark near-black background with a cyan/blue trend-line and glowing blue 'TUNE' wordmark paired with orange gradient bars and a white 'BUELL' wordmark. The cyan (diagnostics/technical/electronic) to orange (energy/performance/combustion) gradient visually narrates the brand's dual focus: electronic ECU diagnostics feeding into tangible performance gains.

nodes.label: Hardware/Software Fusion Brand Concept
nodes.rationale: The banner fuses a physical-hardware motif (a Pegasus-winged crest built from angular motorcycle-fairing shapes, rendered in metallic and racing-orange gradients) with a software/telemetry motif (a glowing cyan circuit overlay of nodes and connection lines layered directly across the wing, plus a matching cyan-glow 'TUNE' wordmark). The intent is to visually communicate that BuellTune is ECU diagnostics/calibration software for Buell motorcycles: the wing/feathers reference the bike and its power band, while the circuit overlay and cyan glow reference the digital tuning/telemetry layer connected to it.
